notes:
Initial inbound from founder (Samira Lopez). Building small sales enablement app for SMB GTM teams. Wants hosted, self-serve path first — low ops overhead. Key details / call notes:
- Use-case: record sales calls, generate concise 3–5 bullet summaries, auto-populate CRM notes and provide embedding-backed search over past calls. Also extracting named entities (contact, company, deal amount) for tagging.
- Traffic profile: 200–600 calls/mo initially, spikes after webinars. Typical call length 20–40m. Latency: not strict for summary generation (a few seconds acceptable) but want streaming for transcript ingestion.
- Cost sensitivity: high. Will evaluate token costs; likely to start with small model profile then upgrade if accuracy gaps. "If it costs more than $X/month we won't keep it" (paraphrase).
- Models: prefers open / community models (cost) but receptive to Redwood curated small models if unit economics are better. Interested in recommendation for quantization and batching to reduce cost.
- Security/PII concerns: legal asks: what PII is stored by default, retention controls, redaction at ingestion, opt-out & deletion APIs, export of raw audio/transcripts, and whether keywords can be auto-redacted. Concerned about storing credit card numbers, SSNs, and customer PII in generated summaries.
- Retention questions: wants 7-day raw transcript retention by default, 30–90 day derived summary retention configurable. Asking if retention controls can be self-serve in Console or require support.
- Compliance: SMB but legal insists on basic audit logs, ability to integrate SSO (SAML), and US-only residency for customer data.
- Integration notes: Frontend uses WebRTC -> backend uploads to hosted API. Wants example of prefix caching so repeated summaries don't cost extra.
- Competitive mentions: evaluating Otter, Chorus — differentiator for Redwood: cost/caching, easy model swap, transparent token billing.
- Quote from founder on call: "We need something that just works for reps — simple admin controls for retention and a cheap monthly bill."
- Founder open to trial: will spin up POC with 2 power users if we provide quickstart + example Node SDK snippet and 1000 free summary tokens.
- Legal next: will send list of required security artifacts (SOC2 scope, encryption details).
